description: Time series of hourly resolution Solar-PV generation for European Scale Energy system studies is a data set deposited in DTU Data by its authors Shubham Nayak, Matti Juhani Koivisto (Technical University of Denmark). This dataset provides Pan-European simulated hourly time series of solar PV generation to be used with Balmorel energy system model which can be used to study future European scale energy system. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1343576153 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
